name: Add-on / modular feature priced separately but grouped
expected: Add-on SKU (e.g. GoAnywhere Advanced Workflows) is priced SEPARATELY and ADDITIVELY as its own line, grouped with the primary product lines in the same transaction, deriving its net from its own catalog list with NO bundle override unless a Bundle_Based_Adjustment row gates the (Product, ParentProduct) pair. V21 step 25 'Bundle Based Adjustment Entries' (BundleDiscount BKM over the Bundle_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table, source object BundleBasedAdjustment) is the gate; absent a matching row, the line keeps its own list/net (no override).
actual: Real UAT data confirms additive, separately-priced, grouped behavior. 10 real priced GoAnywhere Advanced Workflows add-on OrderItems exist (list 5497.25 USD each) each carrying its OWN positive NetUnitPrice, e.g. on Order 801WC00000hKXezYAG the add-on appears as 3 independent lines (NET 8152.85, 1848.24, 8152.85) sitting in the SAME order alongside ~17 other GoAnywhere primary product lines (Secure Folders NET 3397.02, SFTP Server 1698.51, Cloud Connector Premium 1053.81, Advanced Agent 3512.55, etc.) - each line priced on its own merits, none zeroed/absorbed. A real UI-priced base bundle line (GoAnywhere Enterprise Bundle, QLI 0QLWC000002yEvH4AU) nets 121141 = list exactly (additive at own list). Bundle gate is wired and active but does NOT match this pair: BundleBasedAdjustment has exactly 1 row (00001221) targeting Product=Data Detection Engine under Parent=DCS Essentials Bundle, AdjustmentType=Percentage 7, effective 2026-01-01 -> open-ended; 0 rows touch the GoAnywhere base/add-on pair, so V21 step 25 returns no adjustment and the add-on stays additive. Fresh DML fixture Quote 0Q0WC000003FaW50AK (base GoAnywhere Enterprise Bundle list 121141 + add-on GoAnywhere Advanced Workflows list 5497.25, two lines same quote) Force-repriced through V21 isSuccess:true errorResponse:[]; both lines repriced to NET=0 (LMD 2026-06-30T01:42:23Z) - the documented headless Apex-insert base-seed artifact (QLI.NetUnitPrice is not Apex-writeable under RLM and the place API does not hydrate list->net on Apex-inserted lines), NOT a bundle defect: the SAME base product nets 121141=list on the real UI-path line, proving the $0 is harness-only.
evidence: Real priced add-on OrderItems: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Order/801WC00000hKXezYAG/view (add-on OIs 802WC00000N2VEOYA3 NET=8152.85, 802WC00000N2VEIYA3 NET=1848.24 list=5497.25, alongside 17 grouped primary lines). Real UI-priced base line QLI 0QLWC000002yEvH4AU NET=121141=list (Q 0Q0WC000002dNI90AM). Bundle gate row: BundleBasedAdjustment 15TWC00000MuMdv2AF (00001221) Data Detection Engine under DCS Essentials Bundle = 7% Percentage, eff 2026-01-01->open; DecisionTable Bundle_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table 0lDa50000007BGTEA2 Active SourceObject=BundleBasedAdjustment (= V21 metadata LookUpId). V21 metadata: Data/pricing-v21-validation/live/expressionSetDefinition/Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure.expressionSetDefinition-meta.xml step 'Bundle Based Adjustment Entries' (BundleDiscount, params ParentProductId=MainItemProduct, RootBundleId=RootItemProduct, LookUpId=0lDa50000007BGTEA2). Fixture: scripts/apex/setupAddOnGroupedTestData.compact.apex -> Quote 0Q0WC000003FaW50AK (#00781519) marker 'C-06 FIXTURE CREATED'; Force-reprice isSuccess:true.
notes: Branch traced: V21 step 25 'Bundle Based Adjustment Entries' (execution order #25, parentStep ListContainer41, BundleDiscount BusinessKnowledgeModel) keyed on (ProductId, ParentProductId=MainItemProduct, RootBundleId=RootItemProduct, ProductSellingModelId) into Bundle_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table. The gate is a lookup that ONLY adjusts when a matching BundleBasedAdjustment row exists; the add-on otherwise flows through normal list/discount steps as its own additive line (Quantity*Price + Aggregate). Anti-phantom-defect doctrine applied: the fresh DML fixture's $0 net is the known headless base-seed gap (QLI.NetUnitPrice not Apex-writeable; place API does not hydrate Apex-inserted lines) - confirmed harmless because the identical base product UI-priced nets 121141=list and 10 real add-on OrderItems carry positive nets; the only failing evidence was a headless line, so per the brief that is not a defect. Catalog is source of truth: 'GoAnywhere Essentials/12.65k' in test_setup is illustrative; real catalog values are GoAnywhere Enterprise Bundle list 121141 USD and GoAnywhere Advanced Workflows add-on list 5497.25 USD (both active USD PBEs on the live Fortra Price Book, TermDefined annual SM 0jPWC000000060b2AA). defect_provenance=none/catalog-derived; no regression ticket. Positive gate proof: DCS Essentials Bundle / Data Detection Engine 7% override is Active and effective today, demonstrating the bundle gate fires when (and only when) configured. No deploys/edits; validation-only.
verdict_reason: Real UAT data shows the GoAnywhere Advanced Workflows add-on priced separately and additively as its own line (10 priced OrderItems, e.g. NET 8152.85 / 1848.24 on Order 801WC00000hKXezYAG) grouped with the primary product lines, with no override because 0 BundleBasedAdjustment rows match the pair while the gate is provably wired/active for the one configured DCS pair - exactly the expected 'additive, grouped, no override unless bundle gate' behavior; the fixture's headless $0 net is the documented Apex-insert artifact, not a defect.
